title: US Lawmakers Press OpenAI to Explain Firing of 2 Employees
summary:
A group of US legislators led by Representative Joe Casar has called for a detailed explanation from OpenAI regarding the recent dismissal of certain staff members who had reported internal safety risks. The inquiry focuses on the motivations behind the terminations and whether the company is penalizing employees for flagging potential dangers associated with its AI models.

The congressional request specifically addresses the firing of 2 employees who claim that their removal was meant to discourage other staff from sharing information with third-party investigators. These former employees stated that the company's leadership decisions create a chilling effect on the reporting of safety issues, a point that lawmakers have highlighted in their inquiry to the AI developer.
